name: Analyze Cns Lesion Histology
description: Analyzes histological images of CNS lesions to quantify immune cell infiltration, demyelination, and tissue damage.
detailed_description: Analyzes histological images of CNS lesions to quantify immune cell infiltration, demyelination, and tissue damage.
when_to_use: When you need analyze cns lesion histology analysis

parameters.image_path: [Required] Path to the microscopy image file of brain or spinal cord tissue section (str)
parameters.stain_type: [Optional] Type of histological stain used (options: "H&E", "LFB", "IHC") (default: H&E)
